summary: Iteration 4 — IA Match v4 (10 articles + 10 lessons + 15 templates + IA Match logo + Google Favicons fallback). Backend: 12/13 pytest passed (1 minor word-count miss on n2/n4). Frontend: blocking Metro syntax error fixed (duplicate Image import removed in app/(tabs)/index.tsx); after restart all v4 flows verified — IA Match logo renders in Catalogue header, Actue lists 1 featured (n1 GPT-5.5) + 9 rows for 10 total, /news/n1 detail renders markdown body with GPT-5.5 content, Academy Fundamentals shows 10 lessons l1–l10, Academy Templates shows 15 templates with level filter (level-ALL/BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED) restricting BEGINNER to 5 items. minor.issue: Articles n2 (GPT Image 2.0) = 250 words and n4 (Mistral) = 282 words — both below the 300-word target stated in the spec. n1=327, n3=407, n5=304, n6=360 meet target. Pre-existing n7/n8/n9/n10 are short by design. Content edit only, no functional issue.

issues: Persistent React Native Web 'shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings in expo logs (cosmetic, carried from prior iterations).

Console shows many ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED entries — these are Clearbit logo URLs that fail DNS in this environment, which is exactly why LogoTile falls back to Google Favicons. Fallback chain is functioning as specified; the noisy errors are inherent to the chain being exercised on every tile.

action_items: Optional: lengthen body of n2 (GPT Image 2.0) from 250 → 300+ words and n4 (Mistral) from 282 → 300+ words to fully satisfy the spec's 300-word minimum on the 5 hero articles.

Optional: silence Clearbit 404s by skipping Clearbit attempt entirely (use Google Favicons as primary) since Clearbit is unreachable in this environment — would clean the console and slightly reduce LCP.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of red-screen blocker: a stray `import { Image } from 'react-native'` at line 14 of /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx duplicated the named Image already imported in the multi-line block at lines 2–11, producing a `SyntaxError: Identifier 'Image' has already been declared`. Reproduction: open the web preview before fix → Metro red error screen with the SyntaxError stack. Mitigation: deleted line 14 and restarted expo via `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`; bundler now compiles and the Catalogue (with new IA Match logo) renders correctly.
